title: ChronoLink: Anchor & Echo
tagline: Change the past and reshape its ruins. 28 co-op chambers with shared timber, ironwood, flooded courts and sluice wheels.

roles.name: The Anchor (1924)
roles.description: WASD and E. Carries timber, acorns and iron shores, shoves crates and routes water. Everything left behind ages into 2026.

roles.name: The Echo (2026)
roles.description: Arrows and Enter (F or . to pin). Holds and pins tiles, topples crates, fells ironwood, drains flooded basins, jams future sluices, kicks rusted bars and opens the Stash Box.

multiplayer.style: asymmetric co-op, split screen or two tabs
multiplayer.notes: Split screen on one keyboard by default. A second tab links automatically over BroadcastChannel('chronolink-sync'); the Online button links two devices through the hub relay with a 4-letter code.
